scope: Bounded review of six official ancillary dataset families; not exhaustive. No RapidMapping activation inventory research. Existing files were read but not modified.

notes: Dynamic official bodies and raw downloads took precedence over stale search or web-renderer representations.
A supported request date is not proof of returned observations. Reference datasets available in 2026 are not necessarily observations acquired in 2026.
Unbounded real-time EFFIS archives were not downloaded. No API keys were requested or inspected.

datasets.name: AEMET station weather and daily climatology

access.free_evidence: Official information page verified through web browser states free downloading; direct snapshot attempt returned HTTP 500.
access.response_workflow: First response gives datos and metadatos URLs; fetch the referenced resources. No authenticated request made.
access.key_policy_as_of_cutoff: New keys have three-month validity. Notice published 2026-10-15 describes progressive retirement of keys without expiration, including intermittent authentication failures.

coverage.recent_hourly: Latest 12 hours only according to specification; unsuitable to reconstruct July from an October request.
coverage.daily: Date-range endpoint supports historical requests; actual station-specific 2026 availability unverified without a key.
coverage.includes_2026: Documented service operating in 2026; no 2026 weather observations downloaded

license.name: AEMET general reuse authorization; not asserted to be CC BY
requirements: Credit AEMET, retain update-date and reuse metadata, avoid distortion and implied endorsement.

uncertainty: Choose stations from the inventory before asserting proximity to an incident.
No hourly historical archive verified here.
